episode.episode_title: The hidden bottleneck in AI growth
episode.episode_description: US data-centre projects face local and political scrutiny. We explain what Reuters actually reported, what remains unknown, and the practical lesson for AI-dependent businesses.
episode.selection_reason: Lead story checked directly against Reuters reporting, with attributed analyst forecasts and specific unresolved uncertainties.

short.script: New AI data centres face more scrutiny in parts of the United States.
